headline.title: First flakes for Adirondacks.
headline.text: Up to {{s:2}} on the summit of Whiteface Saturday afternoon to early Sunday, and {{s:6.7}} for the week. 12 of the 31 resorts close to opening get nights cold enough to make snow, mostly in Western Maine and White Mountains. Killington typically opens first, around Nov 8.

BTV.excerpt:
A cooler and unsettled weather pattern is expected this weekend with some summit level wet snow possible on Sunday morning.
Continued unsettled flow with temperatures falling towards the end of next week.

ALY.excerpt:
) Medium to high chances for rain showers tomorrow across eastern New York and western New England, with no flooding impacts expected.
) Unsettled weather conditions are favored for across eastern New York and western New England next week.

GYX.excerpt:
Beneficial rainfall expands inland tonight with locally heavy rainfall along the coast with more showery conditions expected this weekend.
Cooler temperatures arrive later this weekend and remain through next week areawide. There will be multiple chances for light precipitation, including light snow or snow showers for the higher peaks of the White Mountains.

BUF.excerpt: ) Unsettled weather and cooler temperatures through the weekend.

PHI.excerpt: The weekend will begin with drier, cooler, and breezy conditions in the wake of a departing low pressure system. Winds will diminish with temperatures moderating some for Sunday.

CTP.excerpt: ) Trending seasonably cooler this weekend into next week with bulk of precipitation confined near and southeast of Lake Erie

writeups.name: Vermont
writeups.title: Some snow Friday morning, best at Mount Snow.
paras: Light snow Friday morning to Friday night: Mount Snow {{s:3.2}} at the summits, though the models range from {{r:0,11.1}} at Mount Snow. It's a nor'easter setup, one that usually favors Mount Snow.
Next two days: summit temperatures from {{t:26}} to {{t:47}}, with up to {{s:1.2}} of snow.
Killington usually opens first here, around Nov 8. Jay Peak gets the most hours cold enough to make snow this week (about 34).
Trend: totals have come down since yesterday.
NWS Burlington forecasters, Friday 6:43 PM: "A cooler and unsettled weather pattern is expected this weekend with some summit level wet snow possible on Sunday morning."
writeups.outlook: Days 8 to 14: NOAA's outlook leans slightly warmer than normal and slightly drier than normal.

writeups.name: New Hampshire
writeups.title: Some snow Saturday night, best at Bretton Woods.
paras: The main event runs Saturday night to Sunday morning. Bretton Woods {{s:4.2}}, Cannon {{s:2.9}}, Wildcat {{s:1.3}} at the summits, though the models range from {{r:1.1,5.1}} at Bretton Woods. It's a northwest upslope setup, one that usually favors Bretton Woods, Cannon and Wildcat. Rain mixes in even up high at times. Confidence is low so far (3% odds of {{s:6}}+), so expect changes.
Next two days: summit temperatures from {{t:27}} to {{t:51}}, with up to {{s:4.2}} of snow.
Bretton Woods usually opens first here, around Nov 15. Cannon gets the most hours cold enough to make snow this week (about 22).
NWS Gray forecasters, Friday 6:59 PM: "Beneficial rainfall expands inland tonight with locally heavy rainfall along the coast with more showery conditions expected this weekend."
writeups.outlook: Days 8 to 14: NOAA's outlook leans slightly warmer than normal and slightly drier than normal.

writeups.title: Quiet and mild.
paras: Next two days: summit temperatures from {{t:29}} to {{t:52}}, with rain at times.

insights.text: First flakes: about {{s:1.6}} at the summit Tuesday afternoon to Tuesday night (models {{r:0.1,2.7}}). Snow level near {{e:3200}}, so the base ({{e:1800}}) mixes with or changes to rain Tuesday afternoon: about {{s:0}} there vs {{s:1.6}} up top. Highs stay near {{t:32}} afterward, so some of it should stick up high.

Cold enough to make snow Thursday evening to Friday morning: about 18 hours at or below {{t:26}} at mid-mountain, counting humidity. 2 more cold stretches follow this week. Whether the guns run is up to the resort.
Typically opens around Nov 27, 20 days out.
